verdict.rationale: Cloud Agents run in cloud VMs and do not need your local machine to stay connected. They can be started and managed from Desktop, iOS, cursor.com/agents on any device (including an Android PWA), Slack, or the API. The v1 API treats each agent as durable, with multiple per-prompt runs, and the SDK's cloud runtime is designed to survive the caller disconnecting, which implies a task can be picked up again from another surface. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of handing off a local IDE/CLI session to another device, clear docs on continuing an existing agent's conversation from the web or mobile app, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-device continuation.
